capabilities: Browse SQLite tables and rows with sorting and filtering
Run read-only SQL queries and save results as CSV
Build dashboards of charts, tables and big numbers
Embed dashboard widgets in notes via readout code blocks
Cache dashboard results so they display on mobile via sync
disambiguation: Not a text-to-speech or read-aloud tool; it reads and queries SQLite database files stored in the vault.
extras: Loads the whole database into memory (files over 2000 MB do not open). The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile dashboard viewing depends on Obsidian Sync, which does not carry .db files by default; phone use is mostly limited to cached dashboards.
intentEvidence: ReadOut is a fork of the ICOR for Life SQLite Viewer by myICOR, used under its MIT licence.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open, browse or query SQLite database files stored in a vault.

relations.evidence: ReadOut is a fork of the ICOR for Life SQLite Viewer by myICOR

summary: SQLite browser and dashboard tool that opens .db/.sqlite files in the vault, runs read-only SQL queries, and builds chart, table and big-number dashboards.
